description: REAL execution. Swap one note's value from one asset into another, privately: proves locally (the swapped note's unshield to a one-time escrow, the new note, and a refund note) and sends it through the Gloam relay, never from this server's wallet. Who swapped stays private; the tokens and the amounts are public. A swap spends one whole note: with an amount below a note's value, the note is first split with a private send to this server's own notes. Checked first against the owner's spending limits ("swap" must be listed in the agent's tools) and everything gloam_swap_quote checks. Both new notes are kept before anything is sent; gloam_finish_swap brings back a swap whose money waits at its escrow.

amount.description: How much to swap, in the asset's units. Left out with a note handle: its whole value.

from.description: What you pay: a symbol or a 0x token address. Left out with a note handle: the note's asset.

maxImpactBps.description: The most price impact to accept, in basis points (100 = 1%). It can only lower the owner's cap (GLOAM_SWAP_MAX_IMPACT_BPS, 200 unless set), never raise it.

network.description: Which network to swap on: "robinhood-mainnet", "tempo-mainnet", "base-mainnet", "ethereum-mainnet", "robinhood", "tempo", "base", "ethereum". The -mainnet ones are the mainnets (beta deposit limits); "robinhood", "tempo", "base" and "ethereum" are the testnets. Default here: "robinhood".

note.description: The note handle to swap from (gloam_list_notes). Left out: an exact match, else the smallest note that covers the amount.

to.description: What you receive: a symbol or a 0x token address.

name: gloam_execute_private_swap
title: Execute a private swap
